requirement_vague: Deleting a non-existent todo returns a failing response
requirement_precise: Register a user and login to get an access token. Call DELETE /todos/99999 (an ID that does not exist). Verify the response status code is 404 Not Found.

implementation.reasoning: The DELETE /todos/{id} handler looks up the todo by ID for the authenticated user and explicitly raises an HTTPException with status 404 when no matching todo exists. This satisfies the requirement that deleting a non-existent todo returns 404 Not Found.
